module_summary: Round-robin arbiter: a picker sub-module selects the next requester from a rotating token; grant is registered and held until accepted, then token rotates.

anchors.name: token_r
anchors.why: Round-robin priority pointer, rotated past last grant on release.

anchors.name: sel_r
anchors.why: Registered grant vector captured from picker while idle, cleared on release; drives gnt_o.

anchors.name: busy_r
anchors.why: Two-state idle/granted controller; set on any request, cleared on accept; drives grant valid.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Request vector from N clients into the picker.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Acceptance of current grant; releases arbiter and rotates token.

anchors.name: release_now
anchors.why: Grant accepted this cycle: clears grant register and rotates token.

anchors.name: cand
anchors.why: One-hot winner computed by picker, loaded into grant register.

anchors.name: any_ask
anchors.why: OR of requests; moves controller from idle to granted.

groups.name: rr_picker
groups.description: Rotating token and picker produce one-hot grant, latched into grant register.

groups.name: grant_controller
groups.description: Idle/granted state holds grant until accept, then releases and rotates.
